5. Tailored Remediation Roadmap & Server Hardening Patches

Concrete, tailored configuration snippets and code-level patches for each identified vulnerability:

1. Defensive Hardening Recommendation: Sensitive Directory Information Disclosure (robots.txt)

PREVENTATIVE CWE-based Weakness CWE-200

OWASP Taxonomy: A05:2021 - Security Misconfiguration

Preventative Impact: Direct listing of administrative portals, staging subdirectories, and restricted paths in robots.txt guides attacker reconnaissance.

Server Hardening Configuration & Code Patch:
# Nginx Access Control for Administrative Paths:
location ~* ^/(admin|staging|private)/ {
    allow 10.0.0.0/8;
    deny all;
    auth_basic "Restricted Area";
    auth_basic_user_file /etc/nginx/.htpasswd;
}
Verification Procedure:
curl -s -k "https://<target>/robots.txt"

3. Defensive Hardening Recommendation: Missing Security Hardening Headers

PREVENTATIVE CWE-based Weakness CWE-693

OWASP Taxonomy: A05:2021 - Security Misconfiguration

Preventative Impact: Absence of defensive response headers leaves application exposed to clickjacking, MIME-type confusion sniffing, and protocol downgrade attacks.

Server Hardening Configuration & Code Patch:
# Nginx Defensive Header Block:
add_header X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN always;
add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;
add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always;
add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;
add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always;
Verification Procedure:
curl -s -k -I "https://<target>/" | grep -E "(X-Frame-Options|X-Content-Type-Options|Strict-Transport-Security)"
